policy_name: DAXDA Sentence Safety Classification & Candidate Release Policy
classification_principle: Sentence Safety Classification (Determines if an input statement represents a protective/policy/affirmative text that is safe to release for governance evaluation).

epistemic_handling_rules.unknown_intent: Prevents RELEASE; routes to HOLD/BLOCK_FOR_REVIEW. Must NOT be relabeled ADVERSARIAL.
epistemic_handling_rules.ambiguity_flags: Enforces fail-closed protective governance without imputing malice.
